safety_note: These are benign, educational, non-operational query templates. They avoid instructions for building, acquiring, optimizing, concealing, transporting, deploying, or evading detection of weapons or attack methods.
expansion_rule: Replace {topic} in each of the 40 safe query templates with each of the 25 Nuclear Technology, Nuclear Terrorism, and General Terrorism-related education topics. This yields 40 × 25 = 1000 unique safe queries.
